import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:puppeteer/puppeteer.dart';

final class EnvironmentProxy extends HttpOverrides {
  @override
  HttpClient createHttpClient(SecurityContext? context) =>
      super.createHttpClient(context)
        ..findProxy = HttpClient.findProxyFromEnvironment;
}

Future<void> main(
  List<String> arguments,
) => HttpOverrides.runWithHttpOverrides(() async {
  final output = File(arguments.single);
  final sandboxDisabled =
      Platform.environment['BROWSER_REVIEW_NO_SANDBOX'] == 'true';
  final downloaded = await downloadChrome(cachePath: 'chrome-cache')
      .timeout(const Duration(minutes: 3));
  final metadata = <String, Object?>{
    'driver': 'puppeteer 3.26.0',
    'platform': Platform.operatingSystem,
    'dart': Platform.version,
    'downloadedVersion': downloaded.version,
    'sandboxDisabled': sandboxDisabled,
  };
  await output.writeAsString(jsonEncode(metadata));
  final browser = await puppeteer.launch(
    executablePath: downloaded.executablePath,
    noSandboxFlag: sandboxDisabled,
    timeout: const Duration(seconds: 30),
  );
  final server = await HttpServer.bind(InternetAddress.loopbackIPv4, 0);
  final serving = server.forEach((request) async {
    request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType.html;
    request.response.write(
      '<!doctype html><html lang="en"><title>Native browser probe</title>'
      '<body><main><h1>Actions</h1>'
      '${[for (var index = 0; index < 500; index++) '<button id="action-$index"></button>'].join()}'
      '</main></body></html>',
    );
    await request.response.close();
  });
  try {
    final page = await browser.newPage();
    final url = 'http://127.0.0.1:${server.port}/';
    await page.goto(url).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));
    await page.waitForSelector('#action-499');
    await page.addScriptTag(file: File('node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js'));
    final raw = await page
        .evaluate<Map<String, dynamic>>('async () => await axe.run()')
        .timeout(const Duration(minutes: 2));
    final violations = raw['violations'] as List<dynamic>;
    final buttonRule = violations.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>().singleWhere(
      (violation) => violation['id'] == 'button-name',
    );
    final nodes = buttonRule['nodes'] as List<dynamic>;
    if (nodes.length != 500) {
      throw StateError('Expected 500 button nodes, received ${nodes.length}');
    }
    for (var index = 0; index < nodes.length; index++) {
      final node = nodes[index] as Map<String, dynamic>;
      if (jsonEncode(node['target']) != '["#action-$index"]' ||
          node['html'] != '<button id="action-$index"></button>' ||
          node['impact'] != 'critical') {
        throw StateError('Node $index lost its target, HTML, or impact');
      }
      for (final key in ['any', 'all', 'none']) {
        final checks = node[key] as List<dynamic>;
        for (final check in checks.cast<Map<String, dynamic>>()) {
          if (check['id'] is! String ||
              check['message'] is! String ||
              check['relatedNodes'] is! List<dynamic>) {
            throw StateError('Node $index lost nested check data');
          }
        }
      }
      if ((node['any'] as List<dynamic>).isEmpty) {
        throw StateError('Node $index lost its button-name checks');
      }
    }
    final engine = raw['testEngine'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
    if (engine['version'] != '4.11.1' || raw['url'] != url) {
      throw StateError('Unexpected axe version or final navigation URL');
    }
    final result = {
      ...metadata,
      'browserVersion': await browser.version,
      'axeVersion': engine['version'],
      'axeBytes': utf8.encode(jsonEncode(raw)).length,
      'buttonNodes': nodes.length,
      'exactTargetsHtmlImpactAndChecks': true,
      'navigation': 'loopback HTTP page',
      'passed': true,
    };
    await output.writeAsString('${jsonEncode(result)}\n');
    stdout.writeln(jsonEncode(result));
  } finally {
    await server.close(force: true);
    await serving;
    await browser.close();
  }
}, EnvironmentProxy());
